title: Reflexive mobile capture envelope, version 0.1
description: What the iPhone writes. This is a transport envelope, not a schema 2.1 record. mobile/ingest.py checks it and preserves it into the raw layer. The Structure step later turns raw into schema 2.1 records. Study fields are forbidden here; seeding never touches raw.

capture_id.description: m-<UTC or local compact timestamp>-<random suffix>. Unique per capture.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 with offset, from the phone clock at save time.

capture_type.description: context_loss and handoff are first-class types. marker is the minimum-viable entry.

text.description: De-identified at capture. May be empty for a marker.

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of text, exactly as written.

minutes_since_event.description: How long ago the thing happened. 'unknown' is allowed and is the default.
